denominator.blocked_auth: an unauthorized full round reports BLOCKED_AUTH and does NOT fabricate a zero-score benchmark
denominator.conditional_accuracy: successes / actually-scored; reported as context only, never as the gate metric
denominator.rule: successRate = successes / scheduled attempts (full frozen plan task x variant x arm x repeat); failures, timeouts, missing and blocked rows stay in the denominator with taskSuccess null or false

purpose: Execution protocol v1.5: separately versioned public field roles and representations, matching submission validation, file-safe rg, and targeted source reading. Frozen tasks, gold, scorer, budgets and thresholds stay unchanged; v1.4 and older protocol files and results remain unchanged.

qa_success.authoritative: when --kit-root is given, the frozen kit's qa_contract_pass replaces the preliminary JS outcome (kept as `preliminary`); without a kit the pack says scorer.kind=preliminary-js
requires_all: strict answer equal to frozen gold
every frozen required line (path,start_line..end_line) covered by a SOURCE_RECEIVED event of this attempt (payload-attached slices only)
received source within the task budget (max_lines/max_bytes summed over all SOURCE_RECEIVED rows, as the frozen kit computes it)

receipts.MODEL_PAYLOAD_ATTACHED: minted at the chat request boundary (every request, including the forced final-answer request) for each tool message that request newly carries; contentHash = model-payload hash, rawHash = raw tool result hash
receipts.SOURCE_FETCHED: Raw read windows, java_symbol previews or explicit java_evidence XML units as returned by the tool; diagnostics only, never credited.
receipts.SOURCE_RECEIVED: One row per exact source slice retained in a dispatched tool message: read, java_symbol preview or explicit java_evidence unit. Exact lines/terminators, slice SHA-256 and whole-file hash; metadata, rg/list output and omitted/stale units are not source.
receipts.attention: never claimed; only answer/test results measure understanding
receipts.never_received: tool results that no dispatched request carried (context cap, loop end) stay FETCHED

repair_success.failure: TEST_FAILED, COMPILE_FAILED, REJECTED_*, MISSING_RECEIPT, TIMEOUT, OUTPUT_LIMIT -> taskSuccess false
repair_success.judged_even_if_loop_failed: the candidate tree is judged even when the agent loop failed
repair_success.source: frozen Python judge only (scripts/eval-repair-adapter.mjs evaluateRepair -> python -m harness repair --mode candidate) on the attempt's own candidate tree; patchApplied self-report is never a success
repair_success.unmeasured: BLOCKED_ENV, BLOCKED_SETUP, JUDGE_ERROR -> taskSuccess null, row stays in the denominator; no other judge implementation substitutes

repeat_index: 0-based in the kit (java-specialist-results/v1); 1-based in internal task-eval packs - the adapter converts

schedule.arm_order: armOrder(seed, taskId, repeat): seeded per-task offset rotated by repeat, so the starting arm alternates and the order is reproducible
schedule.plan: buildPlannedAttempts: one flat row per task x arm x repeat (variant primary), written to schedule.jsonl before any attempt runs
schedule.workspace: one fresh candidate per attempt (createAttemptWorkspace refuses an existing root); it is the single read/write/test/java_symbol root; the product session is reopened on a fresh index after every successful write_file or replace_file mutation

scorer.adapter: scripts/eval-frozen-adapter.mjs converts scheduled attempts + SOURCE_RECEIVED rows + provider usage into java-specialist-results/v1; attempts outside the plan and duplicate plan rows are protocol errors
scorer.corpus_mode: bundled-scoped when the kit's own corpora are used; external-full only for a hydrated full checkout; never mixed
scorer.invoke: python3 -m harness --dataset <kit>/dataset score --input <arm>-results.json --split <dev|locked|all> --output <arm>-report.json (run from the kit root; evaluate-java-task --kit-root does this per arm)
scorer.kit_root: docs/java-specialist-release-audit-v1.1/baseline-kit (the original frozen kit; docs/java-specialist-devkit-v1 is byte-identical for dataset/harness after R00)
scorer.no_second_comparator: no String() coercion, no fence stripping, no gold mutation; markdown fences are a format failure (INVALID_ANSWER)
scorer.single_scorer: the frozen kit scorer is authoritative; node-side scoreQaAnswer/receivedLineCoverage are a preliminary mirror locked by tests

strict_json.fences: rejected (strict JSON only in this audit round)
strict_json.keys: exact key set equality with frozen gold; extra and missing keys both fail
strict_json.parser: Shared strict JSON parser rejects decoded duplicate keys, including escaped equivalents, at the new submission boundary and preliminary/frozen adapter boundary; the frozen Python parser and exact comparator are unchanged.
strict_json.values: type identity + deep equality (JS has one number type: int/float not distinguishable - recorded limitation)

both_arms: submit_answer (public keys/types and independently published representation constraints)
product_only: java_evidence (evidence and exact-evidence profiles only; indexed MyBatis XML FQN links)
tools.read_cap: <=400 lines and <=16000 source bytes per call, whole lines; a single over-cap line is an explicit error
repair_both_arms: replace_file (exactly one before occurrence; candidate confined; preserve unrelated bytes)
test (public production build roots and Java release; unsupported complex build is explicit)
tools.argument_validation: Native schemas and execution reject unknown, missing or incorrectly typed parameters. The evaluation java_symbol schema publishes the existing limit 1..20. Explicit preview is forwarded; omitted preview becomes none in the evaluation adapter only.
tools.source_budget: QA source previews, read windows and explicit evidence units share the original max_lines/max_bytes before delivery. Repeated slices remain charged. Valid reads/evidence requests with no remaining lines or bytes stop before source invocation. Whole-line clipping and final wire clipping preserve accurate remaining budget, incomplete-unit state and receipts; fetched-only source is never received.
tools.discovery_projection: Evaluation-only compact candidate projection retains identities and exact source ranges. The public MCP discovery default is unchanged; v1.4 evaluation omitted preview is locator-only. Raw results remain separately journaled.
tools.rg: Accepts either a contained existing file or directory. Runs from candidate root with a relative explicit target and --with-filename. Missing paths are PATH_NOT_FOUND; unavailable rg executable is BLOCKED_ENV. Output remains locator metadata, never source.
tools.read_metadata: totalLines and hasMore survive serialization alongside actual source ranges; source-budget and wire clipping retain whole lines and exact receipts.

usage.kit_row: {source: 'provider', input_tokens?, output_tokens?, cached_input_tokens?} - only measured int fields; all-null becomes null
usage.provider_raw: rawUsage (provider usage object; credentials never appear in it) + rawUsageHash (sha256 of canonical JSON) stored per attempt
usage.unmeasured: null per field, never 0, never bytes/4 estimates

model_protocol.requested_reasoning_effort: none (configured off mapping; new explicit field versus historical run)
model_protocol.observed_behavior: request metadata records settings; provider compliance is not assumed
model_protocol.stop_reporting: Raw provider completions, primaryStopReason, finalAnswerMode and submission audit distinguish ordinary typed submission, public-contract recovery and failed termination.
model_protocol.response_recording: model-completions.jsonl preserves whitelisted response message/tool arguments/finish_reason/usage without authorization or connection fields

public_answer_instructions: Both arms receive identical generic retrieval instructions and separately versioned public field roles, types, array items/order and classification domains. No factual answer values or private required evidence lines are published. Follow located callees/helpers/fields and XML mappings through short targeted source windows; rg/list only locate.
repair_receipt_diagnostics: candidateReceiptValidation checks received source against exact file snapshots captured at fetch; distinct from immutable-base discovery scorer. Frozen invalid diagnostics and external repair judge result are both preserved.
comparison: Historical v1.4 versus v1.5 measures the combined public-contract and retrieval protocol intervention. Within-v1.5 both arms receive identical public rules. Previously exposed tasks remain regression evidence; no claim of independent generalization.

submission.scope: Evaluation host only; both arms use the same typed submission rules. Normal submission requires no extra provider request.
submission.schema: Public answer_keys plus the optional versioned public field schema: pattern/minLength/string enums/array items. Custom lexical order is described publicly and validated by Unicode code point order, not sent as an unsupported JSON Schema keyword. Repair remains unchanged.
submission.boundary: Only an exclusive valid submit_answer can produce an accepted answer. Assistant content is audited draft text. Mixed submit+other tool calls invoke no actions and cannot credit unseen source.
submission.validation: Strict JSON including decoded duplicate keys, exact public key set and types, and only the advertised representation constraints. A valid representation can still be factually wrong. No gold values, coercion, fence extraction or answer-value normalization.
submission.receipts: An accepted submission binds only source receipts already attached to a dispatched request. Fetched results not previously sent cannot be claimed by a simultaneous submit.
submission.recovery: At most one public-contract recovery for missing/invalid/mixed submission; identifies an invalid public field and rule where available. Raw submissions, draft, original stop and extra measured usage remain audited. No gold feedback.
submission.failure: Missing, rejected, truncated or failed submission remains in the scheduled denominator. Repair still judges the actual candidate independently of submission success.
submission.encoding: Canonical serialization of the accepted explicit tool object is the new protocol encoding; it does not clean or rescore historical assistant text.

experimental_evidence.protocol: java-evidence-unit/v1; explicit java_symbol operation=evidence exposed as evaluation java_evidence only in an opted-in product profile
experimental_evidence.input: An already located Java type or method at file/line/column. TYPE follows existing MyBatis resultMap.type facts; METHOD reads independent indexed XML document sources. Neither requires a Java Mapper for resultMap evidence.
experimental_evidence.delivery: One snapshot binds declaration identity and source metadata. Verify current Java/XML file hashes and realpath containment, then deliver exact whole source lines under fixed 8-unit/80-line/16000-byte limits and the original remaining QA budget. No automatic task-complete claim.
experimental_evidence.completeness: complete describes only the specified XML element source range. Unresolved, stale, unparsed, capped or generation-changing cases stay PARTIAL/omitted. Line clipping clears unit completeness.
experimental_evidence.defaults: The normal public query/ranking/preview behavior is unchanged. The earlier passive declaration.range pilot remains reverted.

profiles.broad: v1.5 native + existing broad/static java_symbol with explicit source acquisition
profiles.exact-evidence: native + exact-only declaration lookup + java_evidence; text/terms broad search is not available

experimental_evidence.fairness: control always uses the same native/submit/budget protocol; profile and reader count are recorded with each separate experiment. Source only counts after dispatch, including repeated units.

public_answer_contract.binding: Exact contract bytes are hashed before model calls and recorded per attempt and results pack. Both arms receive identical field descriptions and constraints. Repair keeps its existing patchApplied/summary submission.
